_comment: Pre-encoding config for BabySlakh with the streamgen accompaniment control. 'controls' here names METADATA AUDIO KEYS returned by the custom_metadata_module under __audio__; each is VAE-encoded and fused, in this order, into {id}_controls.npy. The training-side config (preencoded/local_babyslakh_streamgen_preencoded.json) names the resulting LATENT controls and must list them in the same order.
